answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 9669 Country: United Kingdom Title: I am alhumdulilah growing my beard fist long but I have some issue like can I grab my beard from the center (chin hair) and clean the sides so it looks cleaner and nice. Question: I am alhumdulilah growing my beard fist long but I have some issue like can I grab my beard from the center (chin hair) and clean the sides so it looks cleaner and nice. Answer ID: 9669 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2259/2501=D/1429) Ma-shaAllah, you are wearing sunnah beard, may Allah grant it. You can cut the parts of beard exceeding a size of one fist. The hair below chin also should not be cut. Yes, you can cut and clean those at throat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
